description: This is a unit test class for MongoDbUriSupplier, which tests the URI handling and configuration parsing logic related to MongoDB connection URIs, including query parameters, SSL settings, and error conditions.

classes.name: MongoDbUriSupplierTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of MongoDbUriSupplier, including URI parsing, immutability, configuration handling, and query parameter processing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the MongoDbUriSupplier class and its config dependencies are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullConfig
methods.description: Tests that passing null config throws a DittoConfigError with a NullPointerException cause.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithoutUriPath
methods.description: Checks that missing URI path in config triggers an error.

methods.name: preserveMongoDbSourceUriWithoutConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that the source URI is preserved when no additional config options are provided.

methods.name: parseQueryParameters
methods.description: Validates parsing of URI query parameters into a map.

methods.name: preserveQueryParameterOrder
methods.description: Checks that the order of query parameters is maintained.

methods.name: turnOffSsl
methods.description: Tests disabling SSL via configuration modifies the URI appropriately.

methods.name: turnOnSsl
methods.description: Tests enabling SSL preserves the original URI.

methods.name: secondaryPreferred
methods.description: Tests changing the read preference to secondaryPreferred.

methods.name: nullValuesAreNotSet
methods.description: Ensures null config values do not alter the URI.

methods.name: extraParametersAreAppended
methods.description: Checks that additional parameters are appended to the URI.

methods.name: uriWithoutPathOrQueryIsOkay
methods.description: Ensures URI without path or query remains valid.

methods.name: uriWithoutQueryIsConfigurable
methods.description: Tests that a URI without a query string can be extended with options.
